usageNotes: Returns the ordered list of firewall rules applied to a specific QEMU VM, including rule position, action, protocol filters, and enabled/disabled state. Requires VM.Audit permission on the VM path; the node must be online and the VM does not need to be running. Rules are returned in position order (pos field) — this order matters because Proxmox evaluates them top-down.

examples.summary: List all firewall rules for VM 101 on node pve1

tips: The pos field is the authoritative rule order — use it as the index when referencing a specific rule for updates or deletions.
Rules with enable=0 are defined but inactive; check this field to understand why traffic may be passing through unexpectedly.
An action value that doesn't match ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT is a security group reference — the rule delegates to that group's ruleset.
VM-level rules are evaluated after the datacenter and node-level rules; a DROP at the datacenter level will never reach these rules.
